Mr. Wolfe moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried with Mr. White and Mr. Wolfe
voting “YES” and Mr. Moody voting “NO.”

Elizabeth Finochiaro, Grants Manager, provided a staff report.

41,    LEASES/CONTRACTS/LEGAL:

       c)     Minimum Revenue Guaranteed Payment Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
              and the Cheyenne Regional Air Service Focus Team (CRAFT) for Fiscal Year
              ending June 30, 2027. (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund)

Mr. Wolfe moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $380,928.80, seconded by Mr. White.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Brenda Moureaux, Deputy City Treasurer, provided a staff report and Wendy Volk, CRAFT board
member, provided additional information. Chairman Esquibel and committee members White and
Wolfe commented on the item.

       d)      Industrial and Economic Development Services Agreement between the City of
               Cheyenne and the Cheyenne/Laramie County Corporation for Economic
               Development (LEADS) for the period of July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027. (General
               Fund)

Mr. Wolfe moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $100,000.00, seconded by Mr. Moody.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Brenda Moureaux, Deputy City Treasurer, provided a staff report and advised that Rachelle
Zimmerman from LEADS was in attendance for additional questions. Committee member Wolfe
commented on the item.

       e)      Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne and the Cheyenne
               Downtown Development Authority for the Fiscal Year beginning July 1, 2026 and
               ending June 30, 2027. (General Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Wolfe. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Sophia Maes, Downtown Development Authority Executive Director, provided a staff report.
Committee members Moody, White and Wolfe commented on the item.

       I)      Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Office of Youth Alternatives and
               Laramie County School District Number One to provide Crisis Response Services.
               (Revenue to the City)

Mr. Moody moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $300,854.00, seconded by Mr. Wolfe.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
